svg.title: The finished gradebook: both margins agree
svg.desc: The same ten by five score grid, now with both margins filled in pink: ten student averages down the right, five test averages along the bottom, and 72.1 in the green corner box. The lowest test average, 60.1, is ringed and flagged as the Midterm.
svg.text: The finished gradebook: both margins agree
721.0 over 10 students = 72.1. And 360.5 over 5 tests = 72.1. The corner agrees.
If your two margins disagree, one of them used the wrong axis.
